name: Personal Expense Tracker
summary: A simple web application to track personal expenses with functionalities to add expenses, filter by category, and view totals.
requirements: Users can add expenses with date, category, description, and amount.
Users can filter expenses by category.
Users can view the total amount of expenses.
acceptance_criteria: Adding an expense should update the database with the provided details.
Filtering expenses by category should display only expenses that match the selected category.
Viewing the total should display the sum of all expenses.

tasks.title: Set up Flask project
tasks.description: Create a new Flask project with the necessary dependencies (Flask, sqlite3, pytest, pytest-flask, selenium).

tasks.title: Design database schema
tasks.description: Define a SQLite database schema to store expenses with fields for date, category, description, and amount.

tasks.title: Create backend routes
tasks.description: Develop backend routes to handle adding expenses, filtering expenses by category, and retrieving total expenses.

tasks.title: Write backend tests
tasks.description: Create unit tests for the backend routes to ensure they function correctly.

tasks.title: Design HTML templates
tasks.description: Create HTML templates for adding expenses, filtering expenses, and displaying totals.

tasks.title: Implement frontend functionality
tasks.description: Write JavaScript to handle user interactions with the HTML templates, including adding expenses, filtering, and displaying totals.

tasks.title: Write browser tests
tasks.description: Create end-to-end tests using Selenium to ensure the application works as expected in a browser.

tasks.title: Style application with CSS
tasks.description: Add CSS to make the application visually appealing and user-friendly.

tasks.title: Test application
tasks.description: Run all backend and browser tests to ensure the application is functioning correctly.

tasks.title: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a local server or a platform like Heroku for public access.

objective: Build a personal expense tracker where I can add expenses with a date, category, description, and amount, filter by category, and see a total.
